name: TrendVido AI
tagline: Create personalized short videos from photos and ready-made trend templates.
description: TrendVido AI is an independently operated photo-to-video website for social media creators. Choose a ready-made dance, scene or trend template, then upload the photos requested by that template. There is no prompt-writing step or editing timeline. Each template shows its photo requirements and credit cost before generation. Completed videos can be downloaded as MP4 files. The service uses one-time credit packs starting at $9.99 and does not offer a subscription or free trial. Results vary by photo and template. Users must have permission to use the photographs and likenesses they upload. It is not a general text-to-video generator or arbitrary video face-swap editor.
